mapper.select: select mn.*, pre.p_name as projectName,indicator.name as indicatorName,tc.type_name as infoTypeName from pre_project_solution_info mn left join pre_project pre on mn.project_id = pre.P_ID left join znpj_indicator_info_type_config tc on mn.info_type = tc.type_code left join znpj_indicator indicator on mn.indicator_id = indicator.id and indicator.indicator_version_id = mn.indicator_version_id and indicator.status = 1 and indicator.del_flag=1 where mn.id = #{id}
select mn.* from pre_project_solution_info mn where mn.info_type is not null and mn.info_type != '' and mn.indicator_version_id is null and mn.indicator_id is null
